ACRA_TOKEN.purpose: Authenticates crash-reporting operations against the configured ACRA service.

ACRA_URL.purpose: Provides the protected ACRA service endpoint used by release configuration.

ARCORE_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticates Google ARCore API access used by Android builds.

AZP_PRIVATE_KEY.purpose: Private signing key used by AZP release-signing automation.

AZPHALT_PACKAGE_SIGNING_KEY.purpose: Private key used to sign Azphalt package metadata and artifacts.

AZPHALT_PACKAGE_SIGNING_KEY_ID.purpose: Identifies the Azphalt package-signing key used for published signatures.

AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN.purpose: Authorizes deployment to Azure Static Web Apps.

CHAIN.purpose: Legacy PEM certificate-chain material used by Android signing workflows.

CLIENT_ID.purpose: OAuth client identifier injected where a target application requires it.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.purpose: Identifies the Cloudflare account used by deployment workflows.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.purpose: Authorizes Cloudflare deployment and management operations.

CUSTOM_API_KEY.purpose: Application-specific API credential injected by generalized Android release profiles.

FTP_PASSWORD.purpose: Authenticates SFTP/FTP deployment to the configured remote host.

FTP_SERVER.purpose: Protected deployment host value for SFTP/FTP publishing.

FTP_USERNAME.purpose: Authenticates SFTP/FTP deployment to the configured remote host.

GEMINI_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticates requests to the Gemini API.

GH_TOKEN.purpose: Central GitHub token used for cross-repository API, release, status, package, and synchronization operations.

GITHUB_TOKEN.purpose: GitHub-provided per-run token for repository-scoped Actions operations.

GITLAB_PAT.purpose: Authenticates mirroring or synchronization operations against GitLab.

GITLAB_URL.purpose: Protected GitLab endpoint used by mirroring workflows.

GOOGLE_SERVICES.purpose: Complete google-services.json content injected into Android builds that use Firebase/Google services.

GOOGLE_SERVICES_API_KEY.purpose: Google services API key injected into generated Android service configuration.

GPG_PASSPHRASE.purpose: Unlocks the GPG private key used to sign Maven publications.

GPG_PRIVATE_KEY.purpose: Private GPG key used to sign Maven publications.

HF_TOKEN.purpose: Authenticates model and Space operations against Hugging Face.

JULES_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticates Jules API requests for code and repository automation.

KEYSTORE_CHAIN.purpose: Certificate chain paired with the Android signing private key.

KEYSTORE_PRIVATE.purpose: Private key material used to construct or use an Android signing keystore.

KEYSTORE_PUBLIC.purpose: Public certificate/key material paired with Android signing credentials.

KEYSTORE_RAW.purpose: Base64 or raw encoded Android keystore content used for release signing.

KEYSTORE_RSA.purpose: RSA key material used by Android signing workflows.

KEY_ALIAS.purpose: Selects the signing key entry inside an Android keystore.

KEY_PASSWORD.purpose: Unlocks the selected Android signing key entry.

NPM_AUTH_TOKEN.purpose: Authenticates package publication to the configured npm registry.

OSSRH_USERNAME.purpose: Identifies the Maven Central/Sonatype publishing account.

PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.purpose: Google Play service-account credentials used to upload and promote Android releases.

PROJECT_ID.purpose: Protected Google/Firebase project identifier injected into application configuration.

STREETVIEW_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.purpose: Identifies the protected Google Drive folder used by Street View database automation.

TMDB_API_KEY.purpose: Authenticates TMDB API access required by the target application build.

TRAKT_CLIENT_ID.purpose: OAuth client identifier for Trakt integration.

TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET.purpose: OAuth client secret for Trakt integration.

USERNAME.purpose: Legacy protected username consumed by GitLab synchronization automation.

VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY.purpose: Firebase browser API key injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID.purpose: Firebase application identifier injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN.purpose: Firebase authentication domain injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID.purpose: Firebase messaging sender identifier injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.purpose: Firebase project identifier injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET.purpose: Firebase storage bucket injected into Vite builds.

VITE_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY.purpose: Web Push VAPID key injected into Vite/Firebase builds.

VITE_ICAL_FEED_BASE_URL.purpose: Protected iCalendar feed base URL injected into the Vite application.
